name: corporate-clippath
blurb: Image grid with corporate geometric clip path shapes.
description: Renders a 3-column grid of images clipped to corporate-style angular shapes via SVG clip paths. Includes hover scale animation.
use_when: Team sections, professional galleries, or corporate imagery layouts.
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical image edges (clipping hides content); low-end devices (clip-path cost).
a11y: Static grid with image alt text. Clip paths are decorative.
